observation.cause: The initial frozen-object repair extracted the complete R4 payload and loaded the R4 verifier from it, but several test assertions still read predecessor payload paths through the live ROOT/OVERLAY constants. Adding a legitimate V4-only raw-log attribute rule therefore supplied V4 .gitattributes bytes to the R4 verifier.
observation.correction: Route every predecessor payload read in the R4 regression module through the extracted authoring_root/overlay. Keep only the V4-owned bundle, provenance, current-repository mutation sentinel, and Git object-source operations rooted in the live successor checkout.

raw_log.content_policy: Exact PowerShell redirection output from the failed attempt; retained without line-ending normalization or text diff.

nonclaims: The first focused R4 harness pass did not prove that every individual test read used frozen R4 bytes.
This failure does not modify or requalify R4.
No V4 full-gate success is claimed until a later exact run completes with exit code zero.
rollback: Revert the live-read correction only if a replacement keeps every predecessor payload read bound to the exact R4 Git object. Preserve this adverse receipt and raw log.
